children: Indonesia's weather agency said on Tuesday that it has revised its forecast for the start of wet season this year to early November, official said on Tuesday.
The wet season this year and next year will be shorter than normal, and its peak this year in most parts of Indonesia is expected to hit in December, the head of the agency told a press conference.
